hero.title: Celebrating Love, Your Way
hero.subtitle: Unique and personalized wedding ceremonies on the Prosecco hills and beyond.

about.title: My Story
about.bio1: Hi, I'm Noemi Bressan. I am a wedding celebrant based in Pieve di Soligo, in the heart of the enchanting Prosecco Hills in Veneto. I specialize in creating custom wedding ceremonies for couples from all over the world.
about.bio2: I truly believe that every couple deserves a ceremony as unique as their love story. Empathy, flexibility… and some helpful advice to make that day even more special.
about.languagesDesc: Language is never a barrier for love. I am a native Italian speaker and hold a degree in English and German. I also speak Spanish fluently, allowing me to narrate your ceremony in different languages.

wedding.title: Wedding Ceremonies
wedding.desc: Shared ceremony design. From symbolic retreats to official ones with a proxy, I convey the emotion of stories and your life path. Fully customizable texts and rituals in any of the languages I speak.

other.title: Other Services
other.d1: I am a licensed tour guide. I lead groups and individuals on tours of my region—the Prosecco Hills of Conegliano and Valdobbiadene—and throughout the province of Treviso. I organize customized tours, turning every trip into a special memory.
other.d2: I host openings, book presentations, cultural gatherings, and institutional events with elegance, ease, and expertise. By creating an engaging atmosphere and carefully selecting the content and tone best suited to the occasion, I bring life and rhythm to every special event.

addons.title: Additional Services
addons.desc: Site inspections, location advice, direct contacts with witnesses, willingness to travel out of region and abroad. I can provide contacts with excellent professionals such as sound engineers, DJs, and jazz bands.

step1.title: The First Step
step1.desc: Without any obligation, we can organize a video call to evaluate together if I am the right person for your needs. Once the decision is made, we can move on to the next stages.

step2.title: Ceremony Preparation
step2.desc: I will take care of your speech so that it truly reflects who you are. Together we will define the phases of the ceremony, vows, and rituals, so that everything is prepared with care and down to the smallest details.

step3.title: The Ceremony
step3.desc: It's your big day! I will be present at least 45 minutes in advance and will take care of every detail, from the entrance of the couple to the signing of the certificate, to guarantee a smooth and flawless ceremony.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can you celebrate weddings with legal value?
faq.a1: Yes! I am available to celebrate both symbolic ceremonies and official civil rites with proxy.
faq.a2: Absolutely yes. I am available to travel outside Veneto and outside Italy.
faq.q3: Do you provide the audio system?
faq.a3: I can help you by providing contacts for professional microphone audio systems or extra recorded music, from the ceremony to the party.
faq.q4: Do you know live music bands?
faq.a4: Certainly! I have contacts with local bands, especially jazz and acoustic.

reviews.name: Giulia & Denis
reviews.text: Noemi made our day unforgettable. She wrote a ceremony that truly spoke about us, moving all the guests. Her sweetness is unparalleled.

reviews.name: Sarah & Tom
reviews.text: We met Noemi and instantly clicked. She delivered our entire ceremony flawlessly in both Italian and English. Our international guests felt completely involved!

reviews.name: Elena & Roberto
reviews.text: A fantastic experience. She helped us prepare everything, from documents to vows, calmly and professionally. Highly recommended!
